players.detail: Did not practice in the Aug. 26 joint session because of a calf issue first reported after pregame warmups Aug. 21. Matt LaFleur said he will miss some time; no confirmed return has been established.

players.detail: Participated in the Aug. 26 joint practice and took 11-on-11 work, but said afterward he is not quite fully ready yet while returning from offseason knee surgery. He remains confident he will be ready for Week 1.
Participated in the Aug. 26 joint practice as the Packers continue managing his return from a knee injury. No later full-clearance announcement has been confirmed.
